rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for feeling annoyed or bothered, especially by something repeated or troublesome.

example.english: Being rushed by people all the time makes me irritated.
example.traditional: 成日畀人催，我真係好煩躁。
example.jyutping: seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 ceoi1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4 cou3

rows.note: Use this for skin or another body part that is physically inflamed and painful, not for emotional irritation.

example.english: My eye is red and painful, as if it is irritated.
example.traditional: 我隻眼又紅又痛，好似發炎咁。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 ngaan5 jau6 hung4 jau6 tung3 hou2 ci5 faat3 jim4 gam3
